name: Enforced Outcomes & Planning Lifecycle
objectives: Verify updating task status to done is blocked if no outcome is attached
Verify task transitions to done when a valid outcome is provided
Verify draft plans are saved with correct state and owner
Verify plan transition rules are enforced strictly
Verify approved plans decompose into child tasks successfully
Verify plan-to-execution traceability links are readable
Verify cross-company outcome modifications are rejected with 403
Verify registering unsupported outcome types is rejected
Verify plan text and outcome metadata are scrubbed of secrets
Ensure verifier regression chain rolls back to 3.1A
